*   **Framework Overhead:** Standard deep learning platforms (PyTorch, TensorFlow) do not benefit from simply masking out samples during backpropagation because they still backpropagate zero gradients for masked samples and retain compute/memory overhead.
*   **Unknown Hardness:** It is impossible to know beforehand which samples are hard, so intermediate tensors cannot be selectively saved during the first forward pass.
*   **GPU Utilization:** If $b$ shrinks excessively small, GPU utilization drops and no computational time benefit is gained over pruned samples.
